description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'MandatoryModuleException' used in the OpenMRS project to handle cases where mandatory modules cannot be stopped or unloaded. It extends 'ModuleMustStartException' and provides constructors to handle single or multiple module IDs, encapsulating related error messages.

classes.name: MandatoryModuleException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating issues related to mandatory modules that cannot be stopped or unloaded.

methods.name: MandatoryModuleException
methods.description: Constructor invoked when an attempt is made to stop a mandatory module, takes the module ID as parameter.

methods.name: MandatoryModuleException
methods.description: Constructor invoked when an attempt is made to stop multiple mandatory modules, takes a list of module IDs.

methods.name: getModuleId
methods.description: Returns the ID(s) of the module(s) associated with this exception.
